author: NicodemusArcleon
body: Is one Mnemonic per day all that you are able to do? You should be doing multiples a day, with boosters if possible, to maximize your XP from them. I think that Monuments are also a good source of XP at that tier.

author: petr1petr
body:
use candles - torch + occult candle + affinity candle and you will have a lot of mobs of your tier.

wear items that will boost your exp gain - tomes as accessories.

use consumables.

monuments are good. Dungeons are good. raids are good (but hard on lower tiers)

ofc, you can ask for carry, or in kingdom or here or on discord - that will give you lvls, but not orns - and you will be stuck with high lvl, without good class - it will be pain. so it is better to play with them - do dungeons together, so that you will gain some orns..

author: homeless_potato43
body: Iirc arena, memory hunts, and raids are the best xp until you hit t8-9 then it's kinda just a grind to t10/11. If you're in a kingdom you could also ask some of the t10 deep dungeon grinders to add you to the party and you can soak up some xp
